title: Suicide mortality rate
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the number of suicide deaths in a year per 100,000 population.
computation_definitions: The suicide mortality rate is defined as the number of suicide deaths in a year per 100,000 population. The figures provided here represent the Crude Suicide Rate (not age-adjusted).
computation_calculations: (Number of suicide deaths in a calendar year / Total population for the same calendar year) * 100,000
other_info: Suicide deaths are monitored by the Rwanda Investigation Bureau (RIB).
comments_limitations: For more details on methodology, see the linked data source.
target_name: By 2030, reduce by one third premature mortality from non-communicable diseases through prevention and treatment and promote mental health and well-being
indicator_definition: Suicide mortality rate is defined as the number of suicide deaths in a year, divided by the population, and multiplied by 100,000.
goal_meta_link_text: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Metadata (PDF 65.1 KB)
source_other_info_1: Estimates of the suicide mortality rate are produced through a consultative and analytical process led by WHO.
